title: self table allows multiple rows, singleton invariant not enforced
description: The 'self' table is documented as always having exactly one row (the daemon's own identity), but the schema has no enforcement: no CHECK(rowid=1), no UNIQUE on any column that would prevent a second INSERT, no trigger. Code that relies on 'SELECT * FROM self LIMIT 1' silently returns the wrong row if two rows are ever present. Add a BEFORE INSERT trigger that raises ABORT when the table is non-empty, or a single-column UNIQUE constraint, to make the invariant enforceable.
